NCCP delayed-diarrhoea rescue: loperamide 4 mg initially, then 2 mg every 2 hours until 12 hours after the last liquid stool; do not continue this high-dose schedule beyond 48 hours. Provide urgent escalation for fever, dehydration, pain or persistent diarrhoea. This is not the capecitabine-only rescue schedule.
